title: Slovakian Pois Soup
description: A hearty Chinese soup made with Slovakian and pois ingredients.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the pois, carrots, and enough chicken broth to cover the ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions if desired.
